Name: (CP) Space Themed Void Eggs
Author: Laufente
Description:
I fell in love with the space void chicken from siamece's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] and wanted the produce to match its snazzy looks!

Using Content patcher, this mod changes the sprites of Void Eggs, Void Mayonnaise and, for consistency, the Void Pendant.
It also edits item descriptions so they no longer reference the old color scheme.
In case you'd like to use the mod but keep your animals vanilla style, it comes with a recolor of the og void chicken, too (turned off by default.)

You can separately toggle the sprite and text changes for each item and the chicken either ingame with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ (recommended) or by editing the config file.
